objective: 多模态翡翠图像识别，输出颜色、种水、样式、题材

offline_gates.name: offline-gate-runner
offline_gates.purpose: 一条命令运行文本识别、VLM/YOLO 解析、融合和固定样例验收

offline_gates.name: text-recognition
offline_gates.purpose: 中文描述、OCR、主播话术必须能提取颜色/种水/样式/题材

offline_gates.name: vlm-and-yolo-parsing
offline_gates.purpose: VLM JSON/纯文本输出和 YOLO 标签必须归一化到标准翡翠字段

offline_gates.name: offline-examples
offline_gates.purpose: 固定离线样例必须全部匹配预期属性

runtime_gates.name: manifest-readiness
runtime_gates.purpose: 真实图片评估前，标注清单必须包含图片路径和 color/water/style/theme 标签，且图片文件存在

runtime_gates.name: api-batch-recognition
runtime_gates.purpose: 前端/API 必须能上传多张图片并返回每张图片的四类字段、置信度、来源和复核标记
evidence: Manual or automated browser run against /jade-recognition

runtime_gates.name: real-image-evaluation
runtime_gates.purpose: 真实翡翠图片样本必须完成模型/启发式/VLM 输出评估，不能只依赖离线文本样例
evidence: scripts/jade.ps1 evaluate or predict-manifest output on a labeled image manifest

runtime_gates.name: feedback-training-loop
runtime_gates.purpose: 人工修正后的颜色/种水/样式/题材必须能保存、导出、按 batch_id 追踪并进入训练清单
evidence: feedback batch trace plus train-batch-feedback dry-run or training run output

completion_rule: Only mark complete after all offline gates pass and runtime gates are proven with current command output or rendered/API evidence.
